aboutText: Black Bull Electrical has been serving Yarraville and the surrounding suburbs for over a decade, specialising in electrical, solar, and air conditioning services. Our team is dedicated to providing reliable and efficient solutions for both residential and commercial properties. We believe in giving back to the local community, ensuring every job is done with care and professionalism. With 24/7 availability, we are always ready to assist with any property maintenance needs.
servicesText: From electrical installations to solar panel systems and air conditioning repairs, Black Bull Electrical covers it all. We offer comprehensive property maintenance to keep your home or business running smoothly. Our specialised team ensures high-quality workmanship across all services.
